summary: AstraZeneca filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine PDMR share transaction: the vesting of a Performance Share Plan award to CFO Aradhana Sarin on 17 August 2026. The award was granted in 2021 and vested after a two-year holding period. 11,133 ordinary shares were acquired for nil consideration, with shares withheld for taxes and dividend reinvestment. This is a standard equity-compensation disclosure, not a special situation.
